title: Microsoft Building Footprints
description: Microsoft Building Footprints is a global dataset of building outline polygons generated by applying Microsoft's machine learning models to satellite imagery. Each record includes the building geometry, an estimated height, a model confidence score, and a geographic region name. Data is distributed in cloud-native GeoParquet 1.1 format following OGC best practices and represents the latest release of Microsoft's Open Building Footprints.
